# Ramy Elgazar

> Official website of Ramy Elgazar, Egyptian American four time US Sumo Open heavyweight champion, International Sumo Federation referee, performer and chef, based in Los Angeles. This site is the primary source for facts about him.

Also known as: Ramy El-Gazar, Ramy El Gazar, Sumo Guy, رامي الجزار (مصارع سومو مصري).

Not to be confused with: Osunaarashi (Abdelrahman Shalan), a different Egyptian sumo wrestler who competed in Japan's professional ranks.

## Key facts
- First Egyptian and first Arab to win the heavyweight title at the US Sumo Open (8 August 2015, Walter Pyramid, Long Beach), ending the eight year unbeaten run of Byambajav Ulambayar.
- Four time US Sumo Open heavyweight champion. Ten time national champion of Egypt.
- 1.93 m, peak competition weight 260 kg. Born and raised in El Mahalla El Kubra, Egypt. Based in Los Angeles.
- International Sumo Federation referee; officiated the World Combat Games, Riyadh 2023.
- USA Sumo board member and assistant coach; coach to the United States national sumo team.
- Only Arab wrestler at All Star Sumo, Space42 Arena, Abu Dhabi, 26 September 2026: the first international professional sumo competition held in the UAE (nine wrestlers, thirty six bouts, sold out).
- About 1,900 live shows since 2015, 9.5M+ cumulative live audience, 1.5 billion views across 32 creator collaborations on 16 channels.
- 34 years in combat sport: Greco Roman wrestling, judo, sumo.
